summary: Implemented prepared SPARQL Update (prepareUpdate) without running tests or committing. Changes: added Update(prologue, algebra) container in rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py; translateUpdate in algebra.py now returns Update with the final translated prologue (empty request returns Update(Prologue(), [])); evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra; processor.py adds prepareUpdate (mirrors prepareQuery, records _original_args) and passes Update containers through the update processor unchanged; sparql/__init__.py exports prepareUpdate; new test module test/test_sparql_prepared_update.py covers prepare/apply via Graph.update, reuse across graphs and repeated application, initNs, initial bindings, direct evaluation, and container shape. Deviations to review: empty requests return an empty Update container instead of a bare list, so evaluation does not raise; pprintAlgebra now prints the algebra list via its fallback path for updates. Tests were not run, per instructions.
